title: LoWAgent: A Low-Resource Multilingual Benchmark for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27205v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web agents are typically evaluated on English-language interfaces, leaving their ability to operate across the world's multilingual websites largely unexplored. This gap is especially significant for low-resource languages, where standardized resources for evaluating web agents remain limited. To address this gap, we introduce Low-Resource Web Agent Benchmark (LoWAgent), a benchmark for evaluating web agents across different low-resource languages (LRLs) in comparison to the default, English. LoWAgent evaluates web agents across English and four LRLs: Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, and Amharic. The benchmark comprises of six fully localized websites, instantiated across five languages to yield 3,000 task instances. We evaluate three closed-source and five open-source models across all five languages on all six websites. Our findings show that both closed-source and open-source models experience performance degradation for LRLs compared to Engli

translated_title: LoWAgent：面向Web智能体的低资源多语言基准测试
translated_abstract: Web智能体通常在英语界面上进行评估，其跨全球多语言网站运行的能力在很大程度上尚未被探索。这一差距对于低资源语言尤为显著，因为用于评估Web智能体的标准化资源仍然有限。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了低资源Web智能体基准测试，用于评估Web智能体在不同低资源语言（LRL）上相对于默认语言英语的表现。LoWAgent在英语以及四种低资源语言（印地语、孟加拉语、乌尔都语和阿姆哈拉语）上评估Web智能体。该基准包含六个完全本地化的网站，跨五种语言实例化，共产生3,000个任务实例。我们在所有五种语言和所有六个网站上评估了三个闭源模型和五个开源模型。我们的研究结果表明，与英语相比，闭源和开源模型在低资源语言上均出现了性能下降。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个评估Web智能体在低资源语言（印地语、孟加拉语、乌尔都语、阿姆哈拉语）上性能的多语言基准LoWAgent，包含六个本地化网站和跨五种语言的3,000个任务实例，并发现闭源和开源模型在低资源语言上均相比英语出现明显的性能下降。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LoWAgent, the first multilingual benchmark for evaluating web agents on low-resource languages (Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, and Amharic), comprising six localized websites and 3,000 task instances across five languages, revealing that both closed-source and open-source models suffer significant performance degradation on low-resource languages compared to English.
